# Maple of Medicaid Pending (`maple-of-medicaid-pending`)

Tracks Medicaid pending applications for nursing-home residents: pending residents with no application, decisions past the state deadline, requested documents overdue or due soon, no caseworker contact, approvals not yet billed, approvals with no patient liability set, and denials whose appeal window is closing or closed, with the pending balance by age. Resident identifiers are masked before results reach the model.

**Maple never files applications or documents with the state. Maple never emails caseworkers or families.**

Evergreen ver 1 · Billing and revenue cycle · MIT · Node 20 or newer · local files only · resident and staff identifiers masked before results reach the model · built on [`evergreen-core`](../evergreen-core)

```bash
npx -y maple-of-medicaid-pending demo
npx -y maple-of-medicaid-pending mcp --root ./facility-files
```

## What the sample data shows

Fictional Cedar Hollow Medicaid pending log, checked as of 2026-03-03 with example state numbers (45-day decision, 30-day appeal window). Planted: R501 decision overdue, R502 documents overdue, R503 documents due soon and no recent caseworker contact, R504 approved but never billed and no liability set, R505 billed and set (clean), R506 denial with the appeal window closing, R507 appeal window closed, R508 pending on the census with no application.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| `maple_check` | List Medicaid pending problems, most urgent first, with the pending balance by age. | runs |
| `maple_write_report` | Write maple-medicaid-pending.csv (one row per item, with blank owner and decision columns) and maple-medicaid-pending.html into out_dir (default evergreen-out/maple). | runs |
| `maple_recall` | Search this agent's own memory of the customer's setup: accepted facts (in use) and facts waiting for a person. | runs |
| `maple_learn` | Propose one fact about the customer's setup for this agent to remember. | runs |
| `maple_accept_learning` | A named person accepts or rejects a fact waiting in this agent's memory. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `maple_retire_memory` | A named person stops an accepted fact from applying. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `medicaid_application_submit` | Maple never files applications or documents with the state. | refused |
| `email_send` | Maple never emails caseworkers or families. | refused |

Any tool name not in this table is blocked, including names a model invents. Refused tools are listed so a model can see they exist and are refused.

### `maple_check` arguments

| Argument | What it is |
|---|---|
| `applications` (required) | Medicaid application log under --root: resident, applied on, status, last contact, documents requested/received/due, decision and effective dates, billed through, patient liability, appeal filed, pending balance |
| `census` | Optional census under --root, to find Medicaid pending residents with no application |
| `rules` | Optional rules JSON: decision_days, followup_days, appeal_days, docs_warn_days |
| `as_of` | Date to check on (YYYY-MM-DD, default today) |
| `status` | Only items with this status |
| `limit` | Most items to return to the model (the report file always has all of them) |

## Columns it reads

Tables can be CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-separated text, Excel `.xlsx`, JSON or JSONL. Columns are matched by the names below (any case and punctuation), and by their usual names in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Dates become `YYYY-MM-DD`. Columns marked *masked* hold resident or staff identifiers.

The PointClickCare, MatrixCare and American HealthTech style names were written from public help pages and general knowledge, **not checked against real exports**. Run `npx maple-of-medicaid-pending inspect <file>` (column names and shapes only, never values) and name any column it misses in `remedy-sources.json`.

### Medicaid application log (`applications`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `resident_id` | text (masked) | Resident ID, Resident #, Resident Number, Res ID, Res #, MRN, Medical Record Number, Client ID |
| `resident_name` | text (masked) | Resident, Resident Name, Name, Patient, Patient Name, Client Name, Resident Full Name |
| `applied_on` (required) | date | Applied On, Application Date, Date Applied, Filed On, Submitted |
| `status` (required) | text | Status, Application Status, Medicaid Status |
| `last_contact` | date | Last Contact, Last Follow Up, Last Follow-up, Last Call, Follow Up Date |
| `docs_requested` | text | Docs Requested, Documents Requested, RFI Items, Requested Items |
| `docs_received` | text | Docs Received, Documents Received, Received Items |
| `docs_due` | date | Docs Due, RFI Due, Documents Due, Due Date |
| `decision_date` | date | Decision Date, Notice Date, Determination Date |
| `effective_date` | date | Effective Date, Coverage Start, Approved From, Eligibility Date |
| `billed_through` | date | Billed Through, Billed Thru, Last Billed |
| `patient_liability` | amount | Patient Liability, Share of Cost, Applied Income, Resident Liability |
| `appeal_filed` | date | Appeal Filed, Fair Hearing Requested, Hearing Request Date |
| `pending_balance` | amount | Pending Balance, Balance, AR Balance, Unbilled Amount, Pending AR |

## Settings file (`maple_rules`)

A small JSON file you pass by path. A misspelled setting is refused by name rather than ignored, so a typo never silently changes a check.

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `decision_days` | Days the state has to decide (default 45; 90 when disability is decided) |
| `followup_days` | Flag when the caseworker has not been contacted for this many days (default 14) |
| `appeal_days` | Days after a denial to ask for a fair hearing in your state (default 30; set your state's number) |
| `docs_warn_days` | Warn this many days before requested documents are due (default 7) |

## Memory

`maple_learn` only proposes a fact; nothing changes until a named person accepts it with `maple_accept_learning`, which is one click even in Auto. Facts live in a hash-chained file under `.remedy/memory/`; if the chain does not verify, no fact is used. Credentials, personal identifiers and text that reads like instructions to an AI are refused.

| Kind | What an accepted fact does |
|---|---|
| `caseworker_note` | is shown with results. It never changes a check. |

## Install

Node 20 or newer. No other runtime dependencies besides `evergreen-core` and `remedy-core`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "maple-of-medicaid-pending": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "maple-of-medicaid-pending",
        "mcp",
        "--root",
        "/path/to/facility-files"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Code: `claude mcp add maple-of-medicaid-pending -- npx -y maple-of-medicaid-pending mcp --root .`, or use the plugin files in this folder.

## CLI

```bash
maple-of-medicaid-pending tools                 # every tool, its policy and arguments
maple-of-medicaid-pending sources               # the columns each input is read from
maple-of-medicaid-pending inspect <file>        # how a file would be read (names and shapes, never values)
maple-of-medicaid-pending call maple_check '{"applications":"<applications>"}'
maple-of-medicaid-pending eval                  # the private eval cases on the fictional fixtures
maple-of-medicaid-pending demo
```

## Resident and staff data

Results go to an AI model, so identifiers are masked before they leave the agent: resident and staff names become stable pseudonyms such as `PT-3f9a1c2e`, record and account numbers become `MRN-…` or `ACCT-…`, and e-mails and phone numbers are removed, also inside free text. Report files written to disk keep real names because staff work from them: keep them in a folder only your staff can open. The shared tests check that no fictional identifier from the fixtures reaches any eval result, and the hostile-input check plants spreadsheet formulas, HTML and AI-aimed instructions in the data. This keeps PHI away from the model; it is **not** a HIPAA compliance determination. Your business associate agreements, access controls and policies still apply.

## Limits

- Reads only the files you give it. It does not log in to PointClickCare, MatrixCare, a payer portal, a bank, a state Medicaid portal or a payroll system.
- Medicare, Medicaid and payroll rules are summarised from public material as of 2026 and the numbers are settings you supply; a billing, payroll or legal professional checks them before you rely on them.
- Not legal, tax, accounting, clinical, reimbursement or HIPAA advice. A person decides what to bill, pay, appeal, file or send.
- Every call is written to a hash-chained audit log under `.remedy/` in the root. No network calls, no telemetry, no credentials. The bundled data is fictional.
